name: face_celeba_test
description: 6 000 images sampled (seed 1) from the first eight shards of the official test split; as face/eval/antispoof.py extract.
licence: CelebA-Spoof (Zhang et al., ECCV 2020): non-commercial research and educational use only; open download, no signature. Evaluated locally for orientation, never redistributed or committed (face/DATASETS.md).
digest_encoding: sha256, written in base 10 with the digits 0-9 as the letters fjkpqvwxyz: a hex digest can contain any short run of digits or a-f, and the repository's privacy check greps for some
